newsitem.title: CANADA: Management group closes Toronto Sun buy.
newsitem.headline: Management group closes Toronto Sun buy.

text.p: Sun Media Corp, formerly Toronto Sun Publishing Corp, said on Thursday a management group closed a takeover of the company for about C$411 million.
Shareholders approved the buyout on September 24 and Ontario courts gave the deal their okay the following day.
The takeover arose after the management group emerged victorious in an auction by Rogers Communications Inc of its 63 percent holding in the company.
The Sun group has tabloid newspapers across the country which it said account for about 11 percent of total Canadian daily newspaper circulation.
